```yaml
name: Run Bun Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  bun-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Enable corepack and install pnpm
        run: |
          corepack enable
          corepack prepare pnpm@latest --activate

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Install Aptos CLI
        run: |
          curl -L https://aptos.dev/install.sh | sh
          echo "$HOME/.aptos/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Start local testnet
        run: |
          aptos testnet start --network local
          # Wait for the testnet to be fully up
          sleep 30
        env:
          APTOS_HOME: ${{ github.workspace }}/.aptos

      - name: Run Bun tests
        run: bun test
        env:
          APTOS_NETWORK: local
          APTOS_NODE_URL: http://127.0.0.1:8080

      - name: Stop local testnet
        if: always()
        run: aptos testnet stop --network local
```
